correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all possible first ignitions. Centre-first sequences finish after one spread. Leaf-first sequences force the centre, permit exactly one further leaf ignition, and then finish, so at most one leaf can depart from its sign-determined natural class. This yields the stated upper bound and explicit attaining sequences. Exhaustive direct simulation of all 504 signatures on stars with three through eight leaves agrees with the theorem; the computation is corroborative, not the infinite proof.
